roleTitle: Project Manager, Cold Storage Warehouse Automation
jobDescription: The cold storage operator is automating its frozen-goods warehouses with automated storage and retrieval systems installed by an automation contractor while the warehouses keep shipping. The Project Manager runs a warehouse's automation project under the operator's project method: the installation plan and the phased hand-over of aisles, the fortnightly project board report, the contractor management under the works contract, and the closure with the acceptance test evidence. Aisle hand-over acceptance stays with the warehouse manager. The role requires briefing warehouse shift teams on what changes each phase brings. Reports to the head of automation projects; works with the automation contractor, the warehouse managers and the shift teams.
requirements: Runs warehouse automation projects under the operator's project method, including the installation plan and the phased aisle hand-over.
Briefs warehouse shift teams on the changes each phase brings under the change briefing standard.
Manages the automation contractor under the works contract, including instructions and defect notices.
Prepares aisle hand-over acceptance, with acceptance staying with the warehouse manager, and records own responsibility boundaries.
Documents project boundaries and acceptance test evidence at closure.

evidence.text: Project manager on a cold storage operator's automation programme for three years, running the automation projects for two frozen-goods warehouses under the operator's project method with their installation plans and phased aisle hand-overs.
Briefed the warehouse shift teams before each phase under the change briefing standard, with the briefing records signed by the shift leads; fourteen phase briefings across the two warehouses.

Managed the automation contractor under the works contract on both projects, with the contract records holding the site instructions and the twelve defect notices I issued with the contractor's responses.
Prepared the aisle hand-over acceptance packs; the acceptance was the warehouse manager's, recorded on each pack together with which checks were mine and which the warehouse's.
Wrote the closure report for each warehouse with the project boundary statement and the acceptance test evidence signed by the automation contractor and the warehouse manager.

Work sample: one installation plan with its phased hand-over schedule, two signed phase briefing records, one aisle acceptance pack with the manager's acceptance and one closure report, with the programme repository references as a verification trail.

Interviewer 1 note: asked to brief the panel as a night shift team on a sample phase, the candidate listed the three aisles closing and the dates, showed the new pick route on the layout, named the two tasks the shift would stop doing and the one it would start, and asked the shift lead to repeat the closure dates back.

Reference call with the former head of automation projects: confirmed the candidate ran the two warehouse projects and the phase briefings in the period, that aisle acceptance stayed with the warehouse managers, and confirmed the dates.

propositions.text: The candidate ran the automation projects for two frozen-goods warehouses of a cold storage operator for three years under the operator's project method with their installation plans and phased aisle hand-overs, and managed the automation contractor under the works contract with twelve defect notices issued.
propositions.rationale: The resume, the installation plan and the contract records document the projects and the contractor management.

propositions.text: The candidate briefed the warehouse shift teams before each of fourteen phases under the change briefing standard with the briefing records signed by the shift leads, and prepared the aisle hand-over acceptance packs with acceptance staying with the warehouse manager.
propositions.rationale: The resume, the briefing records and the reference call document the briefings and the acceptance boundary.

followUpTargets: Ask for the boundary statement of the warehouse project now starting.
